dataset_version: A2_FashionDataset as provided, images 60x80 RGB, 37,745 labelled rows
preprocessing: embedded in the checkpoint: image_size, channel_mean, channel_std. No separate transformer file.
labels: embedded in the checkpoint under 'classes'; head order is that list
notes: python src/task3/finalise_task3.py -- design C (one shared conv body, one head per target), class-weighted loss 1/sqrt(n), mirror TTA, 20 epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 0.001. Shipped checkpoint is the MEDIAN of 3 repeats by mean macro-F1, not the best. train_model() calls torch.manual_seed(SEED) on entry, so these are repeats at SEED=42 differing by cuDNN nondeterminism, NOT independent seeds. The labels 42/43/44 name the repeats only. macro-F1 with labels= over all classes, including any absent from validation; sklearn's default would drop them and read higher.
design: C - one shared conv body, one head per target, class-weighted loss
where: artifacts/** is gitignored by team convention, so the checkpoint is on the team Drive under artifacts/task3. This file records the numbers, the commit and the sha256 so the weights can be identified without being in the repository.
